primary_goal: Drive visitors to select their shoe size and add the product to their bag or buy it immediately.

friction_points.issue: Missing numerical review rating and star count near the product title and price.
friction_points.evidence: While a badge 'Top bewertet' is shown on the image overlay, there is no numerical star rating or review count visible near the product title 'Nike Sportswear AIR FORCE 1 07' or price 'ab 107,95 €'.

friction_points.issue: Payment options (Klarna, PayPal, Rechnung) are not visible near the primary CTA buy box.
friction_points.evidence: Payment method logos (Rechnung, PayPal, Klarna, Apple Pay) are only displayed at the very bottom footer (Screenshot 8), missing from the buy box area where purchasing anxiety occurs.

friction_points.issue: The primary CTA button text 'Jetzt kaufen' can create commitment anxiety before size selection.
friction_points.evidence: The main black button says 'Jetzt kaufen' located right beneath the mandatory size dropdown 'Bitte Größe wählen'. In German e-commerce, 'Jetzt kaufen' can be perceived as an immediate legally binding purchase commitment rather than adding to cart.

friction_points.issue: Size selection requires opening a select dropdown rather than displaying quick-select chips.
friction_points.evidence: The size selection is hidden inside a closed dropdown menu reading 'Bitte Größe wählen', making stock availability for specific sizes invisible at a glance.

friction_points.issue: Excessive recommended product carousels down the page create choice overload and distraction.
friction_points.evidence: The page features 6 distinct carousel sections ('Varianten dieses Styles', 'Mehr von Nike Sportswear', 'Das passt dazu', 'Gesponsert', 'Styling-Ideen', 'Mehr Inspiration') back-to-back.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we display key payment badges (PayPal, Klarna, Kauf auf Rechnung) directly beneath the buy button, then add-to-cart rate will improve because German shoppers receive immediate reassurance about preferred risk-free payment methods.
hypotheses.change: Insert payment icons (PayPal, Klarna, Rechnung) underneath the 'Jetzt kaufen' button.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we add star ratings and total customer review count right below the product title, then add-to-cart rate will increase because quantitative social proof builds trust faster than a static badge.
hypotheses.change: Display star rating summary (e.g. 4.8 ★★★★★ (412)) under the product title.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we test changing the CTA copy from 'Jetzt kaufen' to 'In den Warenkorb', then CTA click rate will improve because it clarifies that the item is being added to a cart without immediate binding checkout.
hypotheses.change: Change button label from 'Jetzt kaufen' to 'In den Warenkorb'.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we replace the size select dropdown with inline size pill buttons, then add-to-cart rate will increase because shoppers can instantly see available sizes without additional clicks.
hypotheses.change: Replace dropdown menu with a grid of clickable size chips highlighting available and out-of-stock sizes.

quick_wins: Add key German payment method logos (Rechnung, PayPal, Klarna) directly under the main CTA box.
Add numerical star rating and review count next to or under the product title.
uncertainties: Whether clicking 'Jetzt kaufen' opens a cart slide-in drawer or redirects immediately to checkout.
Which sizes are currently in stock or out of stock within the size dropdown menu.
